input.summary: Conform the Deliverable licence in § 14.2 to the perpetual, irrevocable, transferable grant in §§ 13.2–13.3 and extend it to Affiliates and contractors.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have conformed the Deliverable licence to the grant we already agreed in Sections 13.2 and 13.3: a licence we pay for should be perpetual and irrevocable, extend to our Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, and be transferable to an Affiliate or successor. A licence that is revocable at will and expires with the Order Form term would leave us unable to keep using work product created specifically for us; if helpful, we can accept transfer limited to a successor in an M&A transaction.

ops.oldText: Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
ops.newText: Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, reproduce, display, modify, and create derivative works from each Deliverable for their business purposes, transferable to an Affiliate or successor as provided in Section 13.3 and revocable only as permitted by Section 13.3.
